Name: SWAPI - Stardew Valley Web API - let your game send events to a custom web server
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
Stardew Valley Web API, let your game send events to a custom web server, useful for making discord bots, interactive web maps and so on !

You can use the in game configuration menu (via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]) to configure the url of your server and the list of events you want the game to send to the server.

The list of events are all the events listed here : [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Events]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Events[/url] except the ones listed as "Specialised", the UpdateTicking, UpdateTicked and the drawing ones to not spam your server and/or lag the game.

The requests to the server are POST type and the event data are given as form parameters, data listed in the above link are sent to the server as string format with same name + an "eventName" key that let you identify the event : 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PDvhyWZ/Capture-d-e-cran-2024-08-09-a-14-50-43.png[/img]﻿

You can also as a developer call the api given to you to send custom requests with custom datas, here is the API interface : 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/f0Q8sSw/Capture-d-e-cran-2024-08-09-a-15-04-24.png[/img]

You can call it like this :

[code]﻿ISWAPIModApi api = ModEntry.Instance.Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ISWAPIModApi>("tomokisan.SWAPI");
var data = new Dictionary<string, string>
{
﻿{ "eventName", "testEvent" },
﻿{ "customData", "customValue" }
};

Task<string> response = api.sendRequestAsync("POST", data);
[/code]﻿
